trs.20: By those [angels] who extract with violence<sup foot_note=197684>1</sup>
trs.85: By the forceful chargers
trs.22: By the (angels) who tear out (the souls of the wicked) with violence;
trs.203: By those (angels) who pull out (the souls of the disbelievers and the wicked) with great violence.

trs.20: And [by] those who remove with ease<sup foot_note=197685>1</sup>
trs.85: raring to go,
trs.22: By those who gently draw out (the souls of the blessed);
trs.203: By those (angels) who gently take out (the souls of the believers).

trs.20: And [by] those who glide [as if] swimming<sup foot_note=197686>1</sup>
trs.85: sweeping ahead at full stretch,
trs.22: And by those who glide along (on errands of mercy),
trs.203: And by those that swim along (i.e. angels or planets in their orbits).

trs.20: And those who race each other in a race<sup foot_note=197687>1</sup>
trs.85: overtaking swiftly
trs.22: Then press forward as in a race,
trs.203: And by those that press forward as in a race (i.e. the angels or stars or the horses).

translation.text: And those who race each other

trs.20: And those who arrange [each] matter,<sup foot_note=197688>1</sup>
trs.85: to bring the matter to an end,
trs.22: Then arrange to do (the Commands of their Lord),
trs.203: And by those angels who arrange to do the Commands of their Lord, (so verily, you disbelievers will be called to account).

trs.20: On the Day the blast [of the Horn] will convulse [creation],
trs.85: on the Day when the blast reverberates
trs.22: One Day everything that can be in commotion will be in violent commotion,
trs.203: On the Day (when the first blowing of the Trumpet is blown), the earth and the mountains will shake violently (and everybody will die).

trs.20: There will follow it the subsequent [one].
trs.85: and the second blast follows,
trs.22: Followed by oft-repeated (commotions):
trs.203: The second blowing of the Trumpet follows it (and everybody will be resurrected).

trs.20: Hearts,<sup foot_note=197689>1</sup> that Day, will tremble,
trs.85: hearts will tremble
trs.22: Hearts that Day will be in agitation;
trs.203: (Some) hearts that Day will shake with fear and anxiety.

trs.20: Their eyes<sup foot_note=197690>1</sup> humbled.
trs.85: and eyes will be downcast.
trs.22: Cast down will be (their owners') eyes.
trs.203: Their eyes will be downcast.

trs.20: They are [presently] saying, "Will we indeed be returned to [our] former state [of life]?
trs.85: They say, ‘What? shall we be brought back to life,
trs.22: They say (now): "What! shall we indeed be returned to (our) former state?
trs.203: They say: "Shall we indeed be returned to (our) former state of life?

trs.20: Even if we should be decayed bones?"<sup foot_note=197691>1</sup>
trs.85: after we have turned into decayed bones?’ and they say,
trs.22: "What! - when we shall have become rotten bones?"
trs.203: "Even after we are crumbled bones?"

trs.20: They say, "That, then, would be a losing return."<sup foot_note=197692>1</sup>
trs.85: ‘Such a return is impossible!’
trs.22: They say: "It would, in that case, be a return with loss!"
trs.203: They say: "It would in that case, be a return with loss!"

trs.20: Indeed, it will be but one shout,
trs.85: But all it will take is a single blast,
trs.22: But verily, it will be but a single (Compelling) Cry,
trs.203: But it will be only a single Zajrah [shout (i.e., the second blowing of the Trumpet)], (See Verse 37:19).

trs.20: And suddenly they will be [alert] upon the earth's surface.
trs.85: and they will be back above ground.
trs.22: When, behold, they will be in the (full) awakening (to Judgment).
trs.203: When behold, they find themselves on the surface of the earth alive after their death,

trs.20: Has there reached you the story of Moses? -
trs.85: Have you [Prophet] heard the story of Moses?
trs.22: Has the story of Moses reached thee?
trs.203: Has there come to you the story of Mûsâ (Moses)?

verses.text_uthmani: إِذْ نَادَىٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ بِٱلْوَادِ ٱلْمُقَدَّسِ طُوًى

trs.20: When his Lord called to him in the sacred valley of Ṭuwā,
trs.85: His Lord called out to him in the sacred valley of Tuwa:
trs.22: Behold, thy Lord did call to him in the sacred valley of Tuwa:-
trs.203: When his Lord called him in the sacred valley of Tûwâ,

trs.20: "Go to Pharaoh. Indeed, he has transgressed.
trs.85: ‘Go to Pharaoh, for he has exceeded all bounds,
trs.22: "Go thou to Pharaoh for he has indeed transgressed all bounds:
trs.203: Go to Fir‘aun (Pharaoh); verily he has transgressed all bounds (in crimes, sins, polytheism, disbelief).

verses.text_uthmani: فَقُلْ هَل لَّكَ إِلَىٰٓ أَن تَزَكَّىٰ

trs.20: And say to him, 'Would you [be willing to] purify yourself
trs.85: and ask him, “Do you want to purify yourself [of sin]?
trs.22: "And say to him, 'Wouldst thou that thou shouldst be purified (from sin)?-
trs.203: And say to him: "Would you purify yourself (from the sin of disbelief by becoming a believer)?"

trs.20: And let me guide you to your Lord so you would fear [Him]?'"
trs.85: Do you want me to guide you to your Lord, so that you may hold Him in awe?” ’
trs.22: "'And that I guide thee to thy Lord, so thou shouldst fear Him?'"
trs.203: "And that I guide you to your Lord, so you should fear Him?"

trs.20: And he showed him the greatest sign,<sup foot_note=197693>1</sup>
trs.85: Moses showed him the great sign,
trs.22: Then did (Moses) show him the Great Sign.
trs.203: Then [Mûsâ (Moses)] showed him the great sign (miracles).

trs.20: But he [i.e., Pharaoh] denied and disobeyed.
trs.85: but he denied it and refused [the faith].
trs.22: But (Pharaoh) rejected it and disobeyed (guidance);
trs.203: But [Fir‘aun (Pharaoh)] belied and disobeyed.

trs.20: Then he turned his back, striving [i.e., plotting].<sup foot_note=197694>1</sup>
trs.85: He turned away and hastily
trs.22: Further, he turned his back, striving hard (against Allah).
trs.203: Then he turned his back, striving (against Allâh).

trs.20: And he gathered [his people] and called out.
trs.85: gathered his people, proclaiming,
trs.22: Then he collected (his men) and made a proclamation,
trs.203: Then he gathered (his people) and cried aloud,

trs.20: And said, "I am your most exalted lord."
trs.85: ‘I am your supreme lord,’
trs.22: Saying, "I am your Lord, Most High".
trs.203: Saying: "I am your lord, most high."

trs.20: So Allāh seized him in exemplary punishment for the last and the first [transgression].<sup foot_note=197695>1</sup>.
trs.85: so God condemned him to punishment in the life to come as well as in this life:
trs.22: But Allah did punish him, (and made an) example of him, - in the Hereafter, as in this life.
trs.203: So Allâh, seized him with punishment for his last<sup foot_note=155030>1</sup> and first<sup foot_note=155031>2</sup> transgression. [Tafsir At-Tabari]

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَعِبْرَةً لِّمَن يَخْشَىٰٓ

trs.20: Indeed in that is a lesson [i.e., warning] for whoever would fear [Allāh].
trs.85: there truly is a lesson in this for anyone who stands in awe of God.
trs.22: Verily in this is an instructive warning for whosoever feareth (Allah).
trs.203: Verily, in this is an instructive admonition for whosoever fears Allâh.

verses.text_uthmani: ءَأَنتُمْ أَشَدُّ خَلْقًا أَمِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ ۚ بَنَىٰهَا

trs.20: Are you a more difficult creation or is the heaven? He [i.e., Allāh] constructed it.
trs.85: Which is harder to create: you people or the sky that He built,
trs.22: What! Are ye the more difficult to create or the heaven (above)? (Allah) hath constructed it:
trs.203: Are you more difficult to create or is the heaven that He constructed?

trs.20: He raised its ceiling and proportioned it.
trs.85: raising it high and perfecting it,
trs.22: On high hath He raised its canopy, and He hath given it order and perfection.
trs.203: He raised its height, and has perfected it.

trs.20: And He darkened its night and extracted its brightness.<sup foot_note=197696>1</sup>
trs.85: giving darkness to its night and bringing out its morning brightness,
trs.22: Its night doth He endow with darkness, and its splendour doth He bring out (with light).
trs.203: Its night He covers with darkness and its forenoon He brings out (with light)

trs.20: And after that He spread the earth.
trs.85: and the earth, too, He spread out,
trs.22: And the earth, moreover, hath He extended (to a wide expanse);
trs.203: And after that He spread the earth,

trs.20: He extracted from it its water and its pasture,
trs.85: bringing waters and pastures out of it,
trs.22: He draweth out therefrom its moisture and its pasture;
trs.203: And brought forth therefrom its water and its pasture.

trs.20: And the mountains He set firmly
trs.85: and setting firm mountains [in it]
trs.22: And the mountains hath He firmly fixed;-
trs.203: And the mountains He has fixed firmly,

trs.20: As enjoyment [i.e., provision] for you and your grazing livestock.
trs.85: for you and your animals to enjoy?
trs.22: For use and convenience to you and your cattle.
trs.203: (To be) a provision and benefit for you and your cattle.

trs.20: But when there comes the greatest Overwhelming Calamity<sup foot_note=197697>1</sup> -
trs.85: When the great overwhelming event arrives
trs.22: Therefore, when there comes the great, overwhelming (Event),-
trs.203: But when there comes the greatest catastrophe (i.e. the Day of Recompense) -

trs.20: The Day when man will remember that for which he strove,
trs.85: on the Day that man remembers what he has done
trs.22: The Day when man shall remember (all) that he strove for,
trs.203: The Day when man shall remember what he strove for.

trs.20: And Hellfire will be exposed for [all] those who see -
trs.85: and Hell is there for all to see,
trs.22: And Hell-Fire shall be placed in full view for (all) to see,-
trs.203: And Hell-fire shall be made apparent in full view for (every) one who sees.

trs.20: So as for he who transgressed
trs.85: for anyone who has transgressed
trs.22: Then, for such as had transgressed all bounds,
trs.203: Then for him who transgressed all bounds, (in disbelief, oppression and evil deeds of disobedience to Allâh).

trs.20: And preferred the life of the world,
trs.85: and preferred the present life
trs.22: And had preferred the life of this world,
trs.203: And preferred the life of this world (by following his evil desires and lusts),

trs.20: Then indeed, Hellfire will be [his] refuge.
trs.85: Hell will be home;
trs.22: The Abode will be Hell-Fire;
trs.203: Verily, his abode will be Hell-fire;

verses.text_uthmani: وَأَمَّا مَنْ خَافَ مَقَامَ رَبِّهِۦ وَنَهَى ٱلنَّفْسَ عَنِ ٱلْهَوَىٰ

trs.20: But as for he who feared the position of his Lord<sup foot_note=197698>1</sup> and prevented the soul from [unlawful] inclination,
trs.85: for anyone who feared the meeting with his Lord and restrained himself from base desires,
trs.22: And for such as had entertained the fear of standing before their Lord's (tribunal) and had restrained (their) soul from lower desires,
trs.203: But as for him who feared standing before his Lord, and restrained himself from impure evil desires and lusts.

trs.20: Then indeed, Paradise will be [his] refuge.
trs.85: Paradise will be home.
trs.22: Their abode will be the Garden.
trs.203: Verily, Paradise will be his abode.

trs.20: They ask you, [O Muḥammad], about the Hour: when is its arrival?<sup foot_note=197699>1</sup>
trs.85: They ask you [Prophet] about the Hour,
trs.22: They ask thee about the Hour,-'When will be its appointed time?
trs.203: They ask you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) about the Hour - when will be its appointed time?

trs.20: In what [position] are you that you should mention it?<sup foot_note=197700>1</sup>
trs.85: saying, ‘When will it arrive?’, but how can you tell [them that]?
trs.22: Wherein art thou (concerned) with the declaration thereof?
trs.203: You have no knowledge to say anything about it.

trs.20: To your Lord is its finality.<sup foot_note=197701>1</sup>
trs.85: Its time is known only to your Lord;
trs.22: With thy Lord in the Limit fixed therefor.
trs.203: To your Lord belongs (the knowledge of) the term thereof?

trs.20: You are only a warner for those who fear it.
trs.85: you are only sent to warn those who fear it.
trs.22: Thou art but a Warner for such as fear it.
trs.203: You (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) are only a warner for those who fear it,

verses.text_uthmani: كَأَنَّهُمْ يَوْمَ يَرَوْنَهَا لَمْ يَلْبَثُوٓا۟ إِلَّا عَشِيَّةً أَوْ ضُحَىٰهَا

trs.20: It will be, on the Day they see it,<sup foot_note=197702>1</sup> as though they had not remained [in the world] except for an afternoon or a morning thereof.
trs.85: On the Day they see it, it will seem they lingered [in this life] an evening [at most,] or its morning.
trs.22: The Day they see it, (It will be) as if they had tarried but a single evening, or (at most till) the following morn!
trs.203: The Day they see it, (it will be) as if they had not tarried (in this world) except an afternoon or a morning.
